name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn's journey into motorsport began in the coal mines of South Wales, where he honed his skills repairing and maintaining complex machinery. Frustrated by the lack of innovation, he transitioned to motorsport, initially working for a small rally team. His technical expertise quickly propelled him through the ranks, and he became known for his ability to diagnose and resolve intricate mechanical issues with speed and precision.

Rhys's approach to machining blends old-world craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology. He is a firm believer in continuous improvement, always seeking new and better ways to enhance performance. His visionary thinking has led to numerous breakthroughs in engine design and component optimization. A natural mentor, Rhys takes pride in sharing his knowledge and inspiring the next generation of motorsport machinists. He thrives on challenges and relishes the opportunity to push the boundaries of what is possible.

Rhys is a highly sought-after machinist. His ability to combine technical skill, managerial insight, and innovative thinking makes him a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is a man of medium build, with strong hands that show a lifetime of craftsmanship.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Machinery's Handbook'
Whistles Welsh folk songs while working
Insists on using imperial measurements alongside metric
